source_mode.title: Source mode
source_mode.description: fixture = use a bundled test corpus (no network). live_archived = call OpenAlex and archive every response for reproducibility. snapshot = read a previously-archived JSON file from disk.

fixture_id.title: Fixture ID
fixture_id.description: Which bundled fixture to read in fixture mode. "tiny-corpus" is the demo fixture.

query.title: Search query (live mode)
query.description: OpenAlex query string. Only used when source_mode = live_archived.
examples: large language models AND systematic review

filters.title: Filters (live mode)
filters.description: Additional OpenAlex filters as key/value pairs.

max_records.title: Max records (live mode)
max_records.description: Cap on how many records to fetch.

snapshot_path.title: Snapshot path
snapshot_path.description: Absolute path to a previously-archived raw OpenAlex JSON. Only used when source_mode = snapshot.
